question: Before confirming an Interac e-Transfer to someone using Autodeposit, the recipient name shown differs from the person you intended to pay. What should you do?
generated_answer: Interac e-Transfer Autodeposit is a service that allows you to automatically deposit Interac e-Transfer funds into your bank account. To use this service, you must first register your email address and/or mobile phone number with your bank. Once registered, you can then receive Interac e-Transfer funds directly into your bank account without having to enter a security code. If you have registered for Interac e-Transfer Autodeposit and receive an Interac e-Transfer that you did not initiate, it is possible that someone has registered your email address and/or mobile phone number with their bank. To prevent this from happening, it is important to keep your email address and/or mobile phone number secure and not share it with anyone. If you have registered for Interac e-Transfer Autodeposit and receive an Interac e-Transfer that you did not initiate, you should contact your bank immediately to report the issue and to cancel the Autodeposit service. This will help to prevent any unauthorized transactions from being made to your bank account.
